name: Citigroup (Citi)
verdict: A US regulator found that Citibank discriminated against applicants of Armenian origin (2015-2021).
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): Citigroup Inc. (listed; largest holders Vanguard and BlackRock, no state) - a 2023 CFPB consent order found Citibank had a pattern or practice of discriminating against credit card applicants based on Armenian national origin (2015-2021); order ended early in October 2025.

why.text: In 2023 the US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau found that from at least 2015 through 2021 Citibank had a pattern or practice of discriminating against credit card applicants based on Armenian national origin, picking them out by last names ending in -ian or -yan. It ordered the bank to pay a $24.5 million penalty and $1.4 million in redress.
why.messageLine: In 2023 the US consumer finance regulator found that from at least 2015 through 2021 Citibank discriminated against credit card applicants based on Armenian national origin.
